Ah, here's the bug: the `pref2` segment sum is computed as "the first k terms starting at phase `phase`", but the segments we need start at phase (phase + m_start) % P.

Let me re-derive: the full intervals are m_start .. delta-1 (relative), with the phases (phase + m) % P. So the segment sum = the sum of the terms starting at phase (phase + m_start) % P with length k = delta - m_start.

So I need a segment sum starting at an arbitrary phase: seg(start_phase, k) = q*total + pref2[start_phase + r][dst] - pref2[start_phase][dst] ✓ (with start_phase + r ≤ 2P-2 ✓).

So the fix: use start = (phase + m_start) % P.
